body: Founder real-time: fold tower-siege patience (Apple #12833) into the wholistic commander-squad R&D thread rather than leave it a standalone heuristic. The full §26.3 spec (hierarchical RL, learned commander directives to sub-agents) needs a restructured training loop -- genuinely bigger scope, hierarchy depth/branching remains an open founder decision per §26.4. Built a real, smaller, rule-based first step instead: commander_posture_multiplier() (apps/arena_bot/src/main.c) reads the live resource race and scales the tower-patience bonus -- team meaningfully ahead plays PATIENT (1.5x, protect the lead), team meaningfully behind goes AGGRESSIVE (0.3x, can't afford to wait while falling further behind), real MOBA precedent not invented. A genuine team-wide signal now changes individual squad decisions, not just per-bot local info -- a real structural step toward the fractal hierarchy, honestly scoped smaller than the full learned version. Full test_arena.sh + test_10_bots.sh green. Commits REDGARDEN eb44a2e, d451f73.
title: NORTHSTAR §26.3 fractal commander/soldier hierarchy -- first real step, resource-aware team posture
